name: XlTrendlineType
description: Specifies how the trendline that smooths out fluctuations in the data is calculated.

constants.name: xlExponential
constants.description: Uses an equation to calculate the least squares fit through points, for example, y=ab^x .

constants.name: xlLinear
constants.description: Uses the linear equation y = mx + b to calculate the least squares fit through points.

constants.name: xlLogarithmic
constants.description: Uses the equation y = c ln x + b to calculate the least squares fit through points.

constants.name: xlMovingAvg
constants.description: Uses a sequence of averages computed from parts of the data series. The number of points equals the total number of points in the series less the number specified for the period.

constants.name: xlPolynomial
constants.description: Uses an equation to calculate the least squares fit through points, for example, y = ax^6 + bx^5 + cx^4 + dx^3 + ex^2 + fx + g.

constants.name: xlPower
constants.description: Uses an equation to calculate the least squares fit through points, for example, y = ax^b.
